title: eludite.forge.detect output
description: The forge, or `family: none` with `message` ("No supported forge for <remote>").

repository.description: Which forge the remote lives on.

family.description: The forge family: `github` (github.com and GitHub Enterprise Server), `gitlab` (gitlab.com and self-managed), `azure_devops` (dev.azure.com, `*.visualstudio.com` and Azure DevOps Server), `forgejo` (Codeberg and other Forgejo instances), `gitea`, `tangled` (tangled.org, formerly tangled.sh, and its knots), `none` (no supported forge).

owner.description: The owner: a GitHub, Forgejo or Gitea user or organization, GitLab's group path (`group/subgroup`), Azure DevOps' organization, Tangled's handle or DID.

name.description: The repository's name (GitLab: the project's path).

remote.description: The git remote it came from (`origin`).

login.description: A user's login (user name) on the forge; on Tangled their handle, else their DID.

capabilities.description: What this forge offers; the windows and menus show only these.

pull_requests.description: Pull requests (merge requests on GitLab) can be listed and opened.

pull_create.description: Pull requests can be created from Eludite.

reviews.description: Reviews can be submitted (approve, request changes, comment; Azure DevOps' votes).

pending_reviews.description: Review comments can be held pending and submitted together; without it each comment posts at once and submit posts the summary.

review_threads.description: Review comments anchor to a file and line.

thread_resolution.description: Review threads can be resolved and unresolved.

draft_pull_requests.description: Pull requests can be drafts and marked ready.

merge_methods.description: The merge methods the forge knows (the repository may allow fewer; a pull request's `mergeable.methods` says which).

auto_merge.description: Merge when checks pass (GitHub's auto-merge, GitLab's merge when pipeline succeeds, Azure DevOps' auto-complete).

issues.description: Issues (work items on Azure DevOps) can be listed and opened.

labels.description: Issues and pull requests carry labels (tags on Azure DevOps).

milestones.description: Issues carry a milestone (iteration path on Azure DevOps).

checks.description: Checks (check runs and statuses, pipelines, policies) are reported per commit.

check_logs.description: A check's log can be read.

branch_from_issue.description: A branch can be created from an issue.

branch_link.description: The forge records the issue's branch (GitHub's development panel, GitLab's related branch, Azure DevOps' branch link, Forgejo's branch reference); Tangled links by a comment.

work_item_types.description: Azure DevOps: work item types from the project's process.
